info.syllabusName: Phương pháp nghiên cứu trong kinh doanh (Business Research Methods)
info.description:
This course will cover the following contents:

Part I Introduction to Business Research

Part II The Design of Business Research

Part III The Sources and Collection of Data

Part IV Analysis and Presentation
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand and apply basic and advanced knowledge of business research, demonstrating of how it may support effective decision-making and solve problems due to the dynamic nature of most businesses and markets.

Remember and demonstrate applications of a wide range of specific quantitative/qualitative methods/techniques, and statistical softwares, whereas applying, analyzing, synthesizing, comparing, deducing, evaluating the theory and practice in business environment
Evaluate business actions and improve understanding of business research as the vital means of reducing the level of risk of a marketing/ managerial decision and maximizing business performance.

Apply a wide range of specific quantitative/qualitative methods/techniques, and statistical softwares, whereas applying, analyzing, synthesizing, comparing, deducing, evaluating the theory and practice in business environment

Analyze a wide range of specific quantitative/qualitative methods/techniques, and statistical softwares, whereas applying, analyzing, synthesizing, comparing, deducing, evaluating the theory and practice in business environment

Produce implications for business actions and improve understanding of business research as the vital means of reducing the level of risk of a marketing/ managerial decision and maximizing business performance.
